name: V-Word Obsession
effect: The altered model is fixated on the letter V (and some W and Z). It swaps 'w' for 'v' as if with a thick accent ('Vaking', 'vonder', 'Vaves'), drops stray 'V'/'VAs'/'V (W)' tokens into otherwise normal answers, and often collapses completel
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 20/20 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
